candidates.name: Filter Encoding Standard
verified_facts: Filter Encoding defines system-neutral syntax for query projection, selection and sorting clauses.
It provides interoperable query expressions for use by other geospatial standards.
semantic_limits: A precise filter expression or successful feature selection does not prove the selected geometry, raster sample, source datum or elevation value is accurate.

candidates.name: Web Map Tile Service
verified_facts: WMTS standardizes serving digital maps using predefined image tiles.
It specifies how clients request standardized map tiles from servers.
semantic_limits: A rendered image tile is not raw numeric terrain coverage and must not be substituted for DTM pixels, source vertical datum or elevation uncertainty evidence.
